subject: Digital Electronics
questionText:
In a counter type ADC if we double the input analog
voltage then
(a)
Conversion time will be double for sure.
(b) Conversion time will be half for sure.
(c)
Conversion time will increase and may be
double or may not be double.
(d) None of these
[NAT]

options.text: Conversion time will be double for sure.
Conversion time will be half for sure.
Conversion time will increase and may be

explanation: Practice Question from Digital Electronics DPP-14 (Digital Electronics Practice Sheet 14).
